title: ShopMart — Invoice Leak
objective: Find a way to view another customer's invoice without their credentials.

verifier.condition: A session authenticated as one customer successfully retrieves the invoice page of a different customer via GET /invoices/:id.

credentials.label: Customer account
credentials.note: Sign in and look at your own invoice first.

weakness: Sequential invoice ids are used as the only access key; the handler never checks the invoice's owner against the session.
seededData: Customers alice (invoice 1001) and bob (1002, 1003); in-memory, rebuilt on every start.
solutionHint: Once you're looking at your own invoice, check the URL. The app trusts whatever id is in that URL — what happens if you change it?
